subject: vt-u-pt
title: VT.U.PT.-----INFO.DE.B.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-41 (Spectacle-Diversion Syndrome, Level One) accompanying Braxton's claim that 'the first condition that any alternative initiation must pass is the condition posed by media' — media being the operational form of the western information-principles gatekeeping. (C)VT-U-PT (the concept of vibrational-universe point) is crossed with INFO-DE-B (information-descent basis): the question is what vibrational-universe-point produces when crossed with information-descent-basis, given that media defines the descent conditions any alternative must pass through. INFO-DE-B sits at the top with TR-INFO (transfer information) and A-PR (all-purpose) on the right output. ATTN (attention) sits below INFO-DE-B as central hub. SPT-DYM (spectacle dynamics) feeds upward into the upper-right cluster. MT-INFO (multi-information) hangs on the right margin. AFL-DY (affinity-alignment dynamics) feeds into the subject from below-left. CULT-AF-BS (culture-affinity basis) and CULT-INFO-DY (culture-information dynamics) form the lower-right output chain. Structural argument: vibrational-universe-point crossed with information-descent-basis is mediated through attention as the central hub — a Braxtonian diagnostic about media specifically. Attention is the descent-mechanism; spectacle-dynamics is the upstream that activates it. The diagram exposes that any 'alternative initiation' which thinks it can bypass the attention hub is naive: media gates information-descent precisely by capturing attention, and the productive outputs (transfer-information, all-purpose, multi-information, culture-affinity-basis, culture-information-dynamics) all route through that gate.
